描述_EN: The central space of the squares is divided into four medallions, each housing an animal - hare, fawn or caprid - standing out against a green or reserved background. the square is framed by a frieze of reserved lozenges stamped with a dot, set against a monochrome brown band. two decorative polychrome tapestry squares set in linen backdrops. In the center of the square is a stylized plant motif with a small medallion at its heart, surrounded by four long, colored petals.
描述_ZN: 方块的中央空间被分为四个奖章，每个奖章中都有一只动物，野兔、小鹿或卡普瑞，在绿色背景下显得格外醒目，或者是备用。 该广场被一个印有圆点的保留菱形的门楣所框住，在单色的棕色带中显得格外突出。 两个装饰性的多色挂毯方块插在亚麻布背景上。 在广场的中央是一个风格化的植物图案，中间有一个小的奖章，周围有四个长长的彩色花瓣。
